name: ETS variant transcription factor 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ETV1 encodes ETS translocation variant 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: ETV1 rearrangements can occur in Ewing sarcoma and prostate cancer, with multiple fusion partners described.
